value.name: Rosa reflects on unintended speech
value.description: Rosa notices that her own involuntary gesture after speaking resembles Asha's from the previous day, revealing her reflective state.
evidence: she realized, the same gesture Asha had made the day before in an office Rosa had never seen
The gestures of people who have just said something they did not know they were going to say are, perhaps, more similar than the people themselves are.

value.name: Rosa leaves for Tenth Street
value.description: At two-thirty, Rosa puts on her coat and walks to Tenth Street for a meeting.
evidence: She put on her coat at two-thirty and walked to Tenth Street.

value.name: Rosa arrives at the bakery
value.description: Rosa goes into the bakery, notices its layout, and sits where she can watch the door.
evidence: The bakery had a green awning and four small tables in the back room and a glass case in front that held the cannoli
She ordered a coffee and a plain biscotto and sat at the table farthest from the door, which gave her a view of who came in.

value.name: Rosa stops buying treats for herself
value.description: Rosa realizes she has stopped buying herself the pastries she once bought for Mrs. Serrano, suggesting a change in her habits and self-regard.
evidence: the cannoli Rosa had not bought in a long time because she had stopped, for reasons she did not examine, buying things for herself that she had bought for Mrs. Serrano.

value.name: Daniel arrives at the bakery
value.description: Daniel enters the bakery exactly at three o'clock, signaling the start of their meeting.
evidence: Daniel came in at three exactly.

value.name: Rosa notices Daniel's changed appearance
value.description: Rosa observes that Daniel is wearing a softer sweater, is unshaven, and speaks Italian in a way she has never heard from him before.
evidence: He was wearing a sweater she had not seen before, which was a softer sweater than the sweaters he ordinarily wore, and he had not shaved, which she had also not seen before
he stood at the counter and ordered his coffee in passable Italian, which she had also not heard from him before

value.name: Daniel sits down prepared to speak
value.description: Daniel brings his coffee to Rosa's table, sits across from her, and places his hands flat on the table as if rehearsing what he will say.
evidence: He brought his coffee back to the table and sat down across from her and put his hands flat on the table the way people do when they have rehearsed a thing they are about to say.

value.name: Daniel begins apologizing
value.description: Daniel addresses Rosa by name and starts an apology, saying he wants to apologize for three specific things in chronological order.
